title: SCA Minhag of the Week 233: "The Blessing on Lahm Ba’ajeen"

chapters.title: Hacham Yosef Sittehon and Birkat Shamayim

chapters.title: Summary of opinions
chapters.about: Review of the documented opinions regarding the blessing

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the blessing to be recited on Lahm bi'ajin by examining the views of various Hachamim. He explores the distinction between pocket-shaped dough and flat dough with meat on top, and how the ingredients of the dough affect the blessing.
questions: What is the blessing on Lahm bi'ajin?
Does the shape of the dough change the blessing?
Does the filling of the dough affect the blessing?
What role does oil in the dough play in the blessing?
